did: Built IW9 and IW10. IW9 is a teleprompter band for reading aloud, paced by the recorder's own microphone level: a pure step plus the runtime and the band component, on the Read it aloud step and every read card. IW10 opens the interview essay in the owner's own voice: an opening card in the week format, written and checked by the Monday routine, listed first on the phone, and played first after the brand by the essay (template v2). Each went through a line pass, two fresh-context reviews plus delta reviews, and three merges with main (IW18's conflicts resolved).
